author: /root
interpretations: The proof4 and proof6 catalogue entries describe reference consumer formats. The public I11 API accepts canonical_dependency9 only; neither proof4 nor proof6 is a supported public input route. Keep those formats held and reference-only; do not invent routes to test them.

Every schema actually consumed at the public I11 boundary or designated recorded edge requires explicit missing/unknown/version/type controls where applicable. Reference-only schemas must be labelled as unqualified and unreachable rather than counted as exercised public coverage.

All limits apply together. Global 50000-node validation may refuse a 10000-check record before its independent check-count bound because the complete graph consumes nodes too. Preserve both limits; record the dominating predicate truthfully and never claim independent maximum acceptance where the aggregate budget makes it impossible.
Malformed records must fail with typed I11Error after shape guards. Validate key sets/types before indexing; do not treat raw KeyError/TypeError/StopIteration as accepted qualification refusals.

Every proposed mutation control must prove that inputs changed and map to its intended predicate/error; positive data and unused store byte counts remain explicitly separate from actual authority or whole-graph semantic qualification.
